question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3.
solution:
The correct answer is **"the".**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• ** **An **article **should be used in the blank space.

 
 
• **'A' **is **indefinite article** and used to refer a **non specific object** or to **introduce a object, **so it should not be chosen.
 
• **'An' **is indefinite article and used to refer a non specific object or to introduce a object and before noun, so it should not be chosen.
 
• **'The'** is a **definite article** and used to refer a **specific object** or to refer **introduced object**,
 
 
 
• Therefore, **'the' **should be used in the blank. So **option 3** is the answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• An article is a word which usually written** before a noun,** It** defines the noun **as **specific and non specific **noun.
 
• The word **'a', 'an', 'the'** are the articles.
 
• There articles are divided into two parts:
 
 
• **Definite articles:** 'The' is the definite article, It is used to refer specific object.
 
 
• **Example:** *I will buy the bike.*__
 
 
 
• **Indefinite articles:** 'A' and 'An' are indefinite articles used to refer a non specific object.
 __
 
• **Example:** *It is a pen.*__

The current combat readiness has sent a strong message to our (2) adversaries, he said. In an address to the top commanders of **(3) the** IAF on the opening day of a three-day conference, the defence minister said the nations resolve to defend its sovereignty (4) _________ firm and that the people of the country have full confidence in the (5) _________ of its armed forces.*
